source.citation: Alimoradi M, Alghosi M, Iranmanesh M, et al. Epidemiology of Injury in Elite and Amateur Soccer Referees: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis. Sports Medicine. 2025. doi:10.1007/s40279-025-02326-y.

classification.rationale: PDF p. 1 explicitly identifies a systematic review and meta-analysis. Methods pp. 2-4 describe a five-database search, independent screening and pooled analysis; it synthesises 17 underlying studies rather than reporting one primary referee cohort.
classification.tabs1To10: Do not create extractions, extraction_fields, population_groups or population_values. Do not transfer pooled meta-analysis counts, incidence, locations, types, mechanisms or severity into primary-study fields.

paper.whyNoPaperMetadataPatch: The status plus note is sufficient. Do not invent a paper-level taxonomy when the approved bridge already confines its screening audit to metadata.extractionBridge20260730.

minimalProposedLiveChange.paperNote: Systematic review/meta-analysis retained for reference checking only. It synthesises 17 studies of soccer-referee injury epidemiology and is not a primary cohort for Tabs 1-10 extraction. Screen any candidate primary references independently before promotion; do not transfer its pooled estimates.
minimalProposedLiveChange.screening: Preserve all vote, manual, promotion, resolver and resolution state. A later bridge apply may write only its namespaced metadata.extractionBridge20260730 reservation/completion audit object, after every current-row gate passes.

sourceCoverage: PDF p. 1: title, abstract, explicit systematic-review/meta-analysis design and 17-study scope.
PDF pp. 2-4: PRISMA/PERSiST methods, database search, independent selection and data extraction.
PDF pp. 5-12: included-study tables and pooled meta-analysis results reviewed only to confirm they are synthesis outputs, not a primary-cohort payload.
PDF pp. 13-16: discussion/conclusion reviewed; no primary-study extraction is supported.
